core_obligations: Prove (1) implies (2) by base change of relatively ample modules (proof lines 2359-2361).
Reduce to schemes: relative ampleness may be checked \'etale locally on $Y$ (so assume $Y$ a scheme), then refine the fpqc covering so each $Y_i$ is a scheme too (proof lines 2361-2368).

From the properties of relatively ample morphisms, $X_i \to Y_i$ is representable (so $X_i$ is a scheme), quasi-compact and separated; descend quasi-compactness and separatedness to $f$ by the chapter's descent lemmas (proof lines 2369-2374).

Form the quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal{O}_Y$-algebra $\mathcal{A} = \bigoplus_{d \geq 0} f_*\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$, show its formation commutes with flat base change so $\mathcal{A}_i = g_i^*\mathcal{A}$, and conclude the maps $\psi_d : f^*\mathcal{A}_d \to \mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$ pull back to the maps $\psi_{i,d}$ (proof lines 2374-2390).

Lift stalk surjectivity: for every $x_i \in X_i$ some $d \geq 1$ makes $\psi_{i,d}$ surjective on stalks (definition of relative ampleness); for $x \in |X|$ choose $i$ and $x_i$ mapping to $x$ and use that $\mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}} \to \mathcal{O}_{X_i, \overline{x}_i}$ is faithfully flat (proof lines 2390-2404).

Conclude: the open subset $U(\psi)$ of the map-into-relative-Proj lemma equals $X$; the base change of $r_{\mathcal{L}, \psi}$ to $Y_i$ is $r_{\mathcal{L}_i, \psi_i}$, an open immersion by the relative-ample characterization; descend the open immersion to get $r_{\mathcal{L}, \psi}$ an open immersion, hence $X$ is a scheme and $\mathcal{L}$ is ample on $X/Y$ (proof lines 2404-2424).
proof_roadmap: Descend the easy direction by base change.
Reduce to an fpqc covering of schemes using \'etale-locality of relative ampleness.
Descend quasi-compactness and separatedness, then the graded algebra with its flat-base-change compatibility.
Lift stalk surjectivity through faithfully flat stalks, apply the Proj criterion, and descend the resulting open immersion.
difficulty_reason: The proof of (2) implies (1) is a genuine descent argument for a graded algebra: after reducing to schemes via the \'etale-locality of relative ampleness and a refinement of the fpqc covering, it descends quasi-compactness and separatedness, forms $\mathcal{A} = \bigoplus_{d \geq 0} f_*\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$, transfers stalk-wise surjectivity of $\psi_d$ through the faithfully flat stalk maps $\mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}} \to \mathcal{O}_{X_i, \overline{x}_i}$, and concludes via the map-into-relative-Proj criterion plus descent of open immersions.
